_comment: Hero prompts for beets-ai.com resource pages. The system prompt here matches the house style (see skill beets-ai-blog-images / references/educational-style.md). Kept in the repo so a hero can be REGENERATED rather than re-invented. Note the deliberate rule learned on 2026-10-10: no screens, boards, grids or documents with writing — those surfaces make the model add garbled lettering ('Hong Kong education', 'C4D', 'HOSPITAL'). People in a plain room, with blank coloured objects, come back clean.
system: Flat vector editorial illustration for a Hong Kong education website. {scene} Clean geometric shapes, soft flat colour, no lettering anywhere, generous white space on the right, calm and encouraging mood.
negative: text, letters, words, numbers, captions, label, signage, poster, whiteboard writing, screen interface, chart labels, watermark, signature, logo, photorealistic, hyperrealistic, 3D render, glossy plastic, neon, cluttered, busy background, distorted face, extra fingers, uncanny, scary, dark, moody, horror, gibberish signage, copyrighted character
